product_metadata.title: Calphalon 1943289 Classic Nonstick Jumbo Fryer Omelet Pan with Cover, 12", Grey
features: Dual-layer nonstick for easy food release and quick cleanup
Cast stay-cool stainless steel long handle
description: The Calphalon Classic Nonstick 12-Inch Jumbo Fryer Pan is made with dual-layer nonstick for extra-easy food release and cleanup and constructed from durable hard-anodized aluminum for fast and even heating. With its high sides, this nonstick pan is deep enough to hold oil for deep frying, or use it to sauté, stir-fry, brown and more. Includes helper handle for easy carrying and oven-safe tempered glass lid to help foods retain moisture when cooking.

details.Material: Aluminum construction , stainless steel long handle and tempered glass lid
